children: Solaris Energy Infrastructure entered into a purchase agreement to issue $1.25 billion of 7.000% Senior Notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A/Reg S private placement. The notes will be issued at par for net proceeds of approximately $1,227.2 million, with closing expected on October 1, 2026. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, growth capital expenditures, and offering-related fees and expenses.
